tagline: visual creative exploring design, characters, stories, and visual culture.
intro: An independent visual practice exploring graphic design, character design, storytelling, and visual culture. I create visuals driven by ideas, curiosity, and a love for unconventional aesthetics.
about: i’m a visual creative with a bachelor’s degree in mass communication, specializing in new media. i’m passionate about creative media and exploring new ideas through visual expression. through freelance projects and collaborative work, i’ve developed my creative thinking, attention to detail, communication, and problem-solving skills. as the team leader of my graduation project, i helped lead a team whose work received an A+ and won second place in the aim media faculties competition. i’m always looking to expand my skills, explore new creative directions, and develop my own visual language.
